title: Tempe Ghost Tour: The Millz Have Eyez Ghost Hunting Experience
includes: Indoor Access at Casa Loma for Ghost Hunt
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Safety Note: This is a relaxed-paced walking tour with frequent stops. Guests should be comfortable walking and standing for short periods. By purchasing a ticket and attending, guests acknowledge the normal risks of a walking tour and agree to release Get Ghosted Phoenix LLC from liability for trips, falls, or injuries.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Millz Have Eyez takes guests through haunted downtown Tempe for a walking tour that blends real history, local legends, and hands-on ghost hunting. Guests investigate behind the historic Hayden Flour Mill and go inside Casa Loma, Tempe’s first hotel, for an exclusive ghost hunt.

This tour is perfect for first-timers, skeptics, locals, and anyone looking for a spooky night out on Mill Ave.
